text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA and have the equivalent of a high school education. 2.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school. 3.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general. 4.Applicants have Chinese proficiency of HSK grade 6 or above; 5.Applicants should attend the entrance examination and meet the requirements of BUAA.
